bet_size_rationale: Run BTC+ETH+SOL+XRP at 1.0% of current available shared cash with one base fill and no top-ups. The two pooled interval HGBs and execution gates remain byte-for-byte frozen; only the shared live timing mask changes. T-150 is common to all four coins and both intervals to reduce timing degrees of freedom. Fixed-model PMData replay through 2026-08-15 UTC produced 443 5m trades at 73.36% WR, +$31.79 PnL, +$0.0718/trade, and $13.09 max DD; 405 15m trades at 73.83% WR, +$40.01 PnL, +$0.0988/trade, and $7.38 max DD. The appended 15m day alone remained slightly negative (-$0.62), so T-150 is an operator-selected shared structure rather than a claim that every recent slice is positive. Both intervals keep the 60s Chainlink/Binance opening contract, 0.10 fee-adjusted edge gate, 6% depth-consumption cap, trend following, no side flip, Tier A off, and the 40% shared-equity drawdown halt.
